chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ammar ibn Marwan, from Jabir, who said:

Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Indeed, the hadith of the family of Muhammad is difficult and deemed very difficult. None believes in it except an angel brought near, or a prophet sent forth, or a servant whose heart Allah has tested for faith.”

So whatever comes to you from the hadith of the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله, and your hearts soften toward it and you recognize it, then accept it. And whatever your hearts recoil from and you deny, then refer it back to Allah, and to the Messenger, and to the knowledgeable one from the family of Muhammad. Rather, the ruined one is he to whom something from it is related which he cannot bear, so he says: ‘By Allah, this was not so; by Allah, this was not so.’ And denial is disbelief.

key_terms.آلِ: the family; here referring to the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْإِنْكَارُ: denial; rejection of what has been transmitted
key_terms.الْعَالِمِ: the knowledgeable one; the authoritative knower from آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
key_terms.حَدِيثَ: hadith; the transmitted teaching or report being conveyed
key_terms.صَعْبٌ: difficult; hard to grasp or bear
key_terms.مُسْتَصْعَبٌ: considered exceedingly difficult; especially hard for people to comprehend

ai.seo_question: What should one do when a hadith from Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام seems difficult to understand or accept?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the hadith of Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام contain profound realities that are not easily borne by all people. What is recognized and received by the heart should be accepted, while what is difficult should be referred back to Allah, His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله, and the learned one from آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ, without falling into denial.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ammar Bin Marwan, from Jabir who said,

‘Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The Ahadeeth of the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww are difficult, becoming more difficult. None will believe in it except for an Angel of Proximity, or a Mursil Prophetsaww, or a servant whose heart Allahazwj has Tested for the Eman.

Thus, whatever is referred upon you all from a Hadeeth of the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and your hearts incline towards it, and you recognise it, so accept it, and whatever your hearts get constricted from and you cannot recognize it, so refer it back to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and to the Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and to the knowledgeable one<sup>asws</sup> from the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>; and rather, the destroyed is when one of you is narrated to with something from it, and he cannot bear it, so he is saying, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This was not so. By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This was not so’. And the denial, it is the disbelief’.
en.sarwar: 1. d ibn Sinan from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from Jabir who has said the following. “Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) has said that the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘The Hadith (statements) of Ahl al-Bayt (members of the family of Prophet Muhammad) is difficult and it becomes difficult. No one believes in it except the angels that are close to Allah or the Prophets who are Messengers also, a servant of Allah whose He has tested for faith.

Whatever would come to you of the Hadith (statements) of Ahl al-Bayt of Muhammad (members of the family of Prophet Muhammad), if your heart would feel relief and you recognized them accept them. Whatever that would cause antipathy in your hearts and you could not recognize leave them to Allah, to the Messenger of Allah and the scholar from Ahl al-Bayt of Muhammad.

The ones to perish are those who do not accept Hadith of Ahl al-Bayt (members of the family of Prophet Muhammad).Whenever one is narrated to them they say, “By Allah, this was not and that was not.” Denial is disbelief.”
